tasks.description: Upgrade Sentry SDK packages from version 7 to version 9 across the entire application stack, including frontend and backend components, while following the official migration documentation.
tasks.details: 1. **Audit Current Sentry Implementation**: Review existing Sentry usage in both frontend and backend code to identify all imports, configurations, and custom integrations. 2. **Update Package Dependencies**: Upgrade @sentry/node, @sentry/react, @sentry/tracing, and any other Sentry-related packages to v9 using pnpm. Remove deprecated packages if any. 3. **Configuration Migration**: Update Sentry initialization code following v9 patterns - replace deprecated options, update integration configurations, and modify error handling setup. Key changes include new SDK initialization patterns, updated performance monitoring setup, and revised error boundary implementations. 4. **Code Refactoring**: Update all Sentry method calls throughout the codebase - replace deprecated APIs like `Sentry.getCurrentHub()` with new equivalents, update transaction creation patterns, and modify context setting methods. 5. **Integration Updates**: Review and update custom Sentry integrations, ensuring compatibility with v9 architecture changes. Update any middleware configurations and error capture mechanisms. 6. **Environment Configuration**: Update environment-specific Sentry configurations, including DSN settings, environment detection, and release tracking setup.
tasks.testStrategy: 1. **Functionality Testing**: Verify error capture works correctly by triggering test errors in both frontend and backend. Confirm errors appear in Sentry dashboard with proper context and stack traces. 2. **Performance Monitoring**: Test transaction creation and performance monitoring features. Verify custom transactions are properly tracked and appear in Sentry performance monitoring. 3. **Integration Testing**: Test Sentry integration with existing error boundaries, async error handling, and custom error reporting mechanisms. 4. **Environment Testing**: Verify Sentry works correctly across development, staging, and production environments with appropriate configuration. 5. **Regression Testing**: Run full test suite to ensure no existing functionality is broken. Pay special attention to error handling flows and user experience during errors. 6. **Dashboard Verification**: Confirm all expected data (errors, performance metrics, user context) appears correctly in the Sentry dashboard with proper formatting and filtering.
